question: Calculate the duration of each track, classify them as short, medium, or long, output the minimum and maximum time for each kind (in minutes) and the total revenue for each category, group by the category.
sql:
WITH track_durations AS (
  SELECT 
    TrackId,
    Milliseconds / 60000.0 AS duration_minutes
  FROM Track
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(duration_minutes) AS min_dur,
    AVG(duration_minutes) AS avg_dur,
    MAX(duration_minutes) AS max_dur
  FROM track_durations
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    td.TrackId,
    td.duration_minutes,
    CASE 
      WHEN td.duration_minutes <= (b.min_dur + b.avg_dur) / 2.0 THEN 'short'
      WHEN td.duration_minutes <= (b.avg_dur + b.max_dur) / 2.0 THEN 'medium'
      ELSE 'long'
    END AS category
  FROM track_durations td, bounds b
),
track_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    category,
    MIN(duration_minutes) AS min_time,
    MAX(duration_minutes) AS max_time
  FROM classified
  GROUP BY category
),
track_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    c.category,
    COALESCE(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 0) AS total_revenue
  FROM classified c
  LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON c.TrackId = il.TrackId
  GROUP BY c.category
)
SELECT 
  ts.category,
  ROUND(ts.min_time, 2) AS min_time,
  ROUND(ts.max_time, 2) AS max_time,
  ROUND(tr.total_revenue, 2) AS total_revenue
FROM track_stats ts
JOIN track_revenue tr ON ts.category = tr.category
ORDER BY ts.category
